description: Under what limits: composable revocation rules one or more grants reference by policyRef. Transcribed from connect docs/contract.md §3 (contract v2), which is canonical. Record key: the policy id, referenced by grant.policyRef. One policy governs many grants. Every rule must hold for a grant to still admit.

rule.description: A tagged rule keyed on `type` (contract §3). New rule types append with no reshape, so `type` lists known values rather than a closed set. Which fields each variant requires is stated in the contract, not expressible here.

type.description: expires — enforceable at redeem AND call time; maxUses — call-time only; burnOnSuccess — one-use, call-time only

n.description: maxUses: the number of successful calls allowed
